req.title: Root endpoint responds
req.statement: The system shall serve a welcome message at GET / with HTTP 200.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states GET / must return HTTP 200 with a specific JSON payload. To achieve high mutation kill rate: (1) positive EP test asserts exact status code 200 and exact JSON keys+values; (2) negative NEG test verifies that POST / returns 405 (wrong method), confirming the handler is method-specific; (3) BVA boundary test asserts the exact version string constant '1.0.0' and exact docs path '/docs' to catch constant mutations; (4) DT test asserts the full response body dict equality to catch any field-name or value mutations. All tests use in-process TestClient, no live URLs.

tests.name: test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload
expected: Response JSON contains message='Welcome to Task Manager API'
trace: R-TASK-018: GET / shall return HTTP 200 with welcome payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["message"] == "Welcome to Task Manager API"
    assert body["docs"] == "/docs"
    assert body["version"] == "1.0.0"

test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload()

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_root_response_content_type_is_json():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert "application/json" in r.headers["content-type"]
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert len(body) == 3

test_root_response_content_type_is_json()

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_root_version_constant_exact_value():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["version"] == "1.0.0"
    assert body["version"] != "1.0.1"
    assert body["version"] != "0.9.9"
    assert body["docs"] == "/docs"
    assert body["docs"] != "/documentation"

test_root_version_constant_exact_value()
